verdict.rationale: Cloudflare open-sources parts of its developer tooling (workers-sdk CLI, and references to the workerd runtime) on GitHub, but the evidence never states a license or confirms the entire Workers platform/runtime is open-source — the core edge service remains closed. Missing for 10: explicit license text, confirmation that the full production runtime (not just CLI/simulator) is open, and independent confirmation of open-source status beyond repo existence.
